title: Acoustic horizons as gravitational horizons
html:
Remark. Acoustic horizons as gravitational horizons

The GR substrate geometry forces the acoustic metric to perfectly match the physical spacetime metric throughout the archimedean realisation. Acoustic horizons function as gravitational horizons: black holes denote strictly regions of supersonic brane fluid flow. The Einstein field equations emerge cleanly as the long-wavelength limit of the q-Navier--Stokes equation, isolating the stress-energy tensor T_{\mu\nu} as the fluid momentum flux. Penrose--Hawking singularity theorems mathematically translate into the structural breakdown of smooth transonic flow. The classical singularity is the q \to 1 degeneration of an originally smooth q-deformed vortex core.
